model.name: RbDiffEditor.applyLanguage R30.41 per-filetype highlight impl
model.description: BUILT v0.7.64: RbDiffEditor.applyLanguage derives the Monaco language id from this.left.path extension (matched against getLanguages().extensions) with a SHEBANG fallback for extensionless scripts (e.g. otmux -> shell), and calls m.editor.setModelLanguage on all 3 models (Local/Result/Repository). Mutates the SAME model instance so the R30.35 change decorations + R30.34 spline PERSIST (coexist, no override); called at the END of loadSide, idempotent. Private helper languageForPath performs the ext/shebang -> language mapping (uncredited support). Expert places [impl:uuid:5e0e5cd5] on the applyLanguage decl source-only (name-match).
